maddeler.e:
اقتعدن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدْنَ (iqtaʕadna) /iq.ta.ʕad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدْنَ (uqtuʕidna) /uq.tu.ʕid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اِقْتَعِدْنَ (iqtaʕidna) /iq.ta.ʕid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
